post.description:
Validate a claim before submission.

Performs comprehensive validation including:
- Missing mandatory documents
- Missing diagnosis
- Missing signatures/authorization
- Coding inconsistencies
- Patient mismatches
- Date inconsistencies
- Duplicate billing
- Document completeness
- Missing credentials/identifiers
Re-validate a claim (clears old findings and creates new ones).

get.description:
Get validation findings for a claim.

Query parameters:
- severity: Filter by severity (critical, high, medium, low, info)
- status: Filter by status (open, acknowledged, fixed, dismissed)
Get validation summary for a claim.

post.description: Acknowledge a validation finding.
Mark a validation finding as fixed.
Dismiss a validation finding with optional reason.

Perform comprehensive medical coding review for a claim.

Reviews:
- ICD codes (invalid, deleted codes)
- CPT codes (invalid, missing modifiers)
- Code combinations (incompatible pairs)
- Diagnosis-procedure compatibility
- Bundling issues
- Medical necessity
Re-review a claim (clears old findings and creates new ones).

get.description:
Get coding review findings for a claim.

Query parameters:
- code_type: Filter by code type (ICD, CPT, HCPCS)
- severity: Filter by severity (critical, high, medium, low, info)
- status: Filter by status (open, acknowledged, fixed, dismissed)
Get coding review summary for a claim.

post.description: Acknowledge a coding review finding.
Mark a coding review finding as fixed.
Dismiss a coding review finding with optional reason.

Predict the probability that a claim will be denied.

Analyzes:
- Missing documentation
- Authorization status
- Coding issues
- Insurance-specific rules
- Historical denial patterns
- Clinical inconsistencies
Re-predict denial probability (updates existing prediction).

get.description: Get denial prediction summary for a claim.
Get full denial prediction details including all risk factors.

post.description:
Detect revenue leakage in a claim.

Analyzes:
- Underbilling
- Missing procedures
- Missing modifiers
- Missed diagnoses
- Missing implants
- Incomplete charges
- Incorrect coding
Re-detect revenue leakage (clears old findings and creates new ones).
